posts.text: ER wait times suck. This weekend at the a student-club hackathon, my team and I built fastER, an AI-powered kiosk designed to make ER intake faster, more accessible, and easier to navigate for patients in different languages. Alhamdulillah, we were honoured to win 1st place! 🥇 In emergency rooms, patients are not treated by arrival time, but by urgency.
